subject.title: [Bug]: The project won't start on Windows and WSL.

question: Should maintainers require focused current-main Windows/WSL repro logs before choosing between a tsdown/rolldown fix and a broader tsc rollback?
rationale: The issue has credible screenshot evidence and affects a documented source-build path, but the requested rollback changes the build system and the exact dependency or wrapper failure is not isolated.

options.title: Require focused repro first
options.body: Run or request current-main native Windows and WSL first-build/second-build logs before choosing a dependency update, wrapper fix, or rollback.

options.title: Sponsor rollback investigation now
options.body: Treat the report as beta-blocking build-tool direction and have a maintainer explicitly compare tsc rollback against tsdown/rolldown repair before implementation.

options.title: Hold for reporter data
options.body: Keep the issue open under needs-info until the reporter supplies full logs, exact Node/pnpm versions, and whether a clean checkout avoids the hang.

recommendation.title: Require focused repro first
recommendation.body: Run or request current-main native Windows and WSL first-build/second-build logs before choosing a dependency update, wrapper fix, or rollback.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the current wrapper-carrying squash and has the strongest recent history in the tsdown/build configuration surface.
